name: nemos-project
description: Nemos - transparent orchestration layer for coding agents (v4.3.0 release)

scripts.test:daemon: cd nemos && node tests/unit-tests.js && node tests/v421-persona-tests.js && node tests/v421-bridge-tests.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:daemon && npm run test:core
scripts.build:core: cd nemos-core && npm install && npm run build
scripts.smoke: cd nemos && NEMONS_PORT=3456 node bin/nemons.js daemon start && sleep 2 && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3456/health | jq . && node bin/nemons.js daemon stop
